Retaining Ring · E-Type

E-Type Retaining Ring (E-Ring)

A retaining ring fitted into a narrow groove machined on a shaft, in the radial direction (perpendicular to the shaft).
Unlike the C-type, it can be pressed into place by hand or with a simple jig without a dedicated plier, so it is widely used for securing small, low-cost parts.
The spec code is designated as ETW.
Note: Please be sure to contact us before precision machining or ordering.
